items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All 8 ACs implemented per the Confidence Calibration Test Completeness Ledger; Codex transport for architecture_internal deliberately NOT built, correctly disclosed as out-of-scope rather than silently added.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: No new runtime I/O surface introduced (docs/skill-prose/config/schema/agent-prompt changes); the new agent is Read/Grep/Glob only, no external calls to guard; record_review_pass.py's new choice validates through existing argparse machinery.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No user input handling, no secrets introduced; the new agent's read-only tool grant plus explicit plan.md prohibition is itself the anchoring-defense/security property this change adds.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: New prose-contract tests assert on actual rendered file content (outcomes), not internal state; extended fixtures (review_record_campaign_shape, review_cascade_handoff) exercise real behavior, not tautologies.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No DB queries, list endpoints, or async handlers touched — markdown/schema/test changes only.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New files land in existing conventions (agents/, skills/*/references/); all new files well under the 300/400 LOC caps; the two grandfathered files brought exactly to their caps (300, 400) rather than over.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: 3 producer/consumer pairs listed in the iterate spec's Affected Boundaries table. Real round-trip probes run against the reviews.json JSON boundary (record+show, plus model-tier-floor positive/negative controls) this session; the architecture_brief.md handoff is covered by AC4's re-read-not-reauthor prose-contract tests.
